verdict.rationale: Bots run on a persistent cloud computer with a filesystem and keep their files across sessions. A files-and-results docs page covers file types like CSV, JSON, YAML, source code and Jupyter notebooks, and the vendor says Bots make custom assets. A hands-on user reports a bot generating a design file (.ai) from a logo and sending it on, which shows real file creation and delivery. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of creating and editing documents and presentations (e.g. docx/pptx/slides), a documented iterative-editing workflow, and documented export/download of results to the user.
